catalogue.name: AGENT_CHANGED
catalogue.description: Agent declared or its credentials changed

catalogue.name: AGENT_RESULT_REFUSED
catalogue.description: Agent result refused: attestation did not verify

catalogue.name: AGENT_SEALING_KEY_REFUSED
catalogue.description: Agent sealing key refused: signature or generation did not verify

catalogue.name: PLUGIN_CHANGED
catalogue.description: Analysis plugin registered, changed or activated

catalogue.name: SARIF_SOURCE_CHANGED
catalogue.description: SARIF import source declared or changed

catalogue.name: SARIF_IMPORT_REFUSED
catalogue.description: SARIF import refused: undeclared source, scope or tool

catalogue.name: CHECKLIST_TEMPLATE_CHANGED
catalogue.description: Checklist template version published or retired

catalogue.name: REPORT_IMPORT_REFUSED
catalogue.description: Report import refused: undeclared source, kind or scope

catalogue.name: SIEM_EXPORT_STOPPED
catalogue.description: SIEM export switched off or redirected

catalogue.name: REPORT_PLUGIN_CHANGED
catalogue.description: Report plugin registered, changed, approved, activated or withdrawn

catalogue.name: REPORT_PLUGIN_REFUSED
catalogue.description: Report plugin refused, or its output refused

catalogue.name: FORGE_CONNECTION_CHANGED
catalogue.description: Forge connection created, its token or trust replaced, or deleted

catalogue.name: FORGE_CONNECTION_REFUSED
catalogue.description: Forge connection refused: blocked destination, write scope, or a credential presented to another host

catalogue.name: TRACKER_CONTRADICTS_TRIAGE
catalogue.description: A tracker contradicts a settled triage decision

catalogue.name: INTEGRATION_TOKEN_STOPPED
catalogue.description: Integration token stopped working: expired or refused
